description: Pick a random winner (or several, without repeats, like spinning with "remove winner" on) from a list of names, or shuffle / sort the whole list. Fair: crypto random with rejection sampling. Entries are trimmed, cut to 100 characters, max 500; at least 2 needed. Optional seed for a reproducible draw. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/wheel-picker/

count.description: How many winners to pick (each winner is removed before the next spin).

items.description: The entries, one per array item.

mode.description: "pick" winners, "shuffle" the list, or "sort" it A→Z.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible result (same seed + same input = same output). Omit for true crypto randomness.

text.description: Or: the entries as text, one per line.

name: random_pick
title: Wheel picker (random pick)
